**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User was spending an average of 2 hours a day on social media before a recent 7-day break.  
[CHANGE] User has taken a recent 7-day break from social media.  
[PREFERENCE] User is trying to get a better understanding of their social media habits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on taking a 7-day break from social media.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of tools and apps to track social media usage:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Screen Time (iOS) - tracks app usage and provides reports.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Digital Wellbeing (Android) - helps understand phone usage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. RescueTime (Web, iOS, Android) - tracks time spent on devices and provides reports.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Moment (iOS, Android) - tracks screen time and social media usage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Freedom (Web, iOS, Android) - tracks usage and blocks distracting websites.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. StayFocused (Chrome extension) - limits access to distracting websites.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Social Media Tracker (Web) - tracks usage across multiple platforms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Hootsuite Insights (Web) - provides analytics on social media usage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Google Chrome's Website Blocker (Chrome extension) - blocks specific websites.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested features to look for in tracking apps:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Time tracking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Customizable goals and limits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Detailed reports.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Blocking or locking features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Multi-device support.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant encouraged the user to experiment with the tools to find the best fit.
